title: Proliferation transitions from a topological phase in $2+1$ dimensions
summary: We consider phase transitions out of a general topological phase in $2+1$ dimensions. We assume that the transition is triggered by a single Abelian anyon, which becomes light near the transition and whose worldlines proliferate after the transition. (This proliferation is often referred to as ``condensation.'') We describe the transition using a continuum field theory obtained by coupling the corresponding topological quantum field theory (TQFT) to a single complex scalar field associated with this anyon.
